characters.name: JUKU
characters.description: Väike 5-aastane poiss tumeblondide lühikeste juustega, seljas punane villane kampsun ja sinised püksid. Sõbralik rõõmsameelne näoilme, suured säravad silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: LIISA
characters.description: Väike 5-aastane tüdruk kahe heleda patsi, rohelise kampsuni ja kollase seelikuga. Rõõmus naeratus, uudishimulikud silmad. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Kodu veranda
locations.description: Cozy indoor wooden porch with light pine walls, natural wooden floor, single large glass window on back wall showing an autumn garden, small light wood table in center, light sunlight streaming inside. Cartoon style.

locations.name: Sügisene aed
locations.description: Sunny autumn garden with green grass scattered with yellow and orange fallen leaves, big sturdy oak tree in center with brown branches, wooden fence in background under blue sky. Bright cartoon style.

pages.scene: Inside cozy indoor wooden porch with light pine walls and wooden floor. Juku (boy in red sweater) and Liisa (girl in green sweater with braids) stand next to a large glass window, pointing and looking outside at tiny birds fluttering outdoors. Sunlight warms the porch.

Inside the wooden porch, Juku and Liisa stand by the small wooden table in the center of the room. They look at each other with happy excited expressions and raised hands, having a bright idea. The large window is behind them.
On the wooden porch, Liisa stands by the wooden table holding up a small clean wooden birdhouse box with a small entrance hole. Juku stands beside her looking happy and clapping his hands.

On the wooden porch table, the small wooden birdhouse sits open. Juku gently pours sunflower seeds from a small ceramic bowl into the wooden birdhouse box. Liisa stands next to him watching closely with a cheerful smile.
On the wooden porch table, Juku holds the small wooden birdhouse while Liisa carefully ties a strong brown rope loop to the top of the box. Both children look focused and happy.

Outside in the sunny autumn garden with yellow and orange leaves on the grass. Juku walks carrying the small wooden birdhouse by its rope, followed closely by Liisa walking happily beside him towards a big oak tree.

In the autumn garden under the big oak tree. Liisa stands on tip-toe reaching up to hang the rope of the wooden birdhouse onto a low sturdy tree branch. Juku stands next to her supporting the birdhouse gently.

In the autumn garden, the wooden birdhouse is hanging securely from the tree branch. Two tiny cute songbirds are perched on the birdhouse eating seeds. Juku and Liisa stand on the grass below, watching quietly with happy smiles.

In the autumn garden, Juku and Liisa stand side by side under the tree with colourful autumn leaves on the ground. They are smiling warmly at the reader, while birds happily eat at the wooden birdhouse on the tree branch in the background.
